out.reference_class: The party finishing second in a Swedish parliamentary election retaining second place at the next election. Across the 15 election-to-election transitions from 1970 through 2022, the runner-up retained its ranking 13 times, a historical frequency of approximately 86.7%. The exceptions were the Centre Party losing second place to the Moderates in 1979 and the Moderates losing it to SD in 2022. Use this as an approximate incumbent-runner-up base rate for one election cycle; the small sample and the Moderates' long period in second place limit its transferability to SD.
